### Question

Probably the [note](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/integration/gitlab/#using-the-uv-image) in the uv documentation saying that a distroless image with an empty entrypoint works on Gitlab should be removed. As per [Gitlab's documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/runner/executors/docker/#configure-a-docker-entrypoint) and issue #9361 a Docker image needs a shell.
